examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The site footer with its four link columns, social row, status line and language select. Edit the props in the Controls panel — clear `home` to drop the Azion mark, `statusLabel` to drop the status line, or `languages` to drop the select.

site.name: Default
site.summary: The site’s own footer: four link columns, then the social row beside the status indicator and the language select. From `lg` the Azion mark leads the social row; below it the mark moves to the signature band.
